page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.32xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by the x86_64 architecture. It features an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.7 GHz, delivering 128 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core configuration. The system is equipped with 1024.0 GB of RAM, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage options.

The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps to support high-throughput data transfers. Because there is no bundled local storage or GPU acceleration, the hardware profile is optimized specifically for workloads that require high memory capacity and dedicated CPU execution without the overhead of local disk management. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and high memory-to-vCPU ratio offer a specialized resource density suitable for enterprise-scale deployments, avoiding the performance fluctuations associated with shared-core environments.

Given its memory capacity of 1024.0 GB and 128 dedicated cores, the ecs.r7.32xlarge is designed for memory-intensive applications. Appropriate workloads include large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning systems, and heavy data processing pipelines that do not require GPU acceleration or local NVMe storage.
